comments.author: derAres
comments.body:
It looks quite good!

If I may give a word of advice. You might wanna have "stages" where you fight in an area that is somehow blocked from moving on. Then defeat all the enemies there, then the block clears and you move on to the next area.

Also, these games need to be very playful to be fun. Allow picking up a trash can and throwing it at them. Shove one into another one and both tumble. Grab a downed one by the foot and swing him into another one (i know the girls here look too weak). Have them break off some fence post and use it as a weapon.

This needs to be crazy playful - then there is a way for it to be cool.

And you need to be able to play it with a friend.

replies.author: FilipeDM
replies.body: Can you create animations of the character picking things up and throwing them?

replies.author: derAres
replies.body: there's some "pick up" and "throw" stuff on mixamo. And also, I had claude build me a tool to create own animations, so the game I currently work on has about 1 forth custom animations.

replies.author: FilipeDM
replies.body: How does this tool work? Do you describe the animations using text?

replies.author: derAres
replies.body: No its an actual tool where you see the char and drag around limbs on a timeline. Then export into game function and tell claude what it is. Probably similar to tools animators use but simplified.
